controls: original held descriptors close on success and failure
coordination: Open only existing checked coordination state. No bootstrap, native command/query, compiler, fixture, helper, capture, release, retry or image publication. Validate the full combined census before and after exclusive observation publication. Retain partial or complete published holds on failure for separately owned recovery.
limits: Only fresh filesystem storage acquisition with inert images and synthetic process births. Stable reuse/full interruption matrix, archive settlement, exact hold release, Python capture integration, actual native ownership/transport, compiler profiles and real contention remain separately owned gates. Existing archive file/aggregate byte limits remain unchanged.
publication: Create only one absent observation reference with the qualified exclusive readback/descriptor-seal writer. Bind evidence path and ordered observer/target births, exact evidence directory identity and current canonical C/executable pair. Existing reference rejects in this leaf; stable reuse belongs to the next child.
qualification_note: Each case records allocations immediately, observes the complete store/workspace/evidence footprint independently, traps fixture/compiler process attempts, retains any published hold on failure and checks every intercepted source descriptor closes. Required rejection stages are fixed from the source contract before fixture execution. No native experiment is authorized.
request: Prior direct owned workspace and isolated evidence-directory path/device/inode identities; closed typed births are data, never native authentication. Workspace uses the existing process-supervisor-tests purpose; evidence cases use .artifacts/logs/native-proxy-observation-acquisition-20260910/cases/fsmgen-<suffix>. Derive all source/reference destinations; accept no caller filename or callback.
result: Inactive acquisition envelope carries the checked permanent lock, target_sources in the fixed order and a separate observation_reference record/source snapshot. runtime_authorized is zero and executable is null. Changing observer-hold metadata never enters target_sources.
source_custody: Hold original checked descriptors through final closure, close them on every path, and return already captured byte/identity snapshots. Matching global/private runtime records must bind the prior workspace and current canonical C/executable identities. Preserve original workspace/tools/evidence/image directory identities and all other holds/images.
